title: Illustration 9: Final Accounts of Mahi and Rahi
title_hi: चित्रण 9: माही और राही के अंतिम खाते
title_gu: ઉદાહરણ 9: માહી અને રાહીના વાર્ષિક હિસાબો
question:
Mahi and Rahi are partners sharing profit-loss in the proportion of 6:4. From the given trial balance dated 31-3-2017 and adjustments, prepare final accounts of partnership firm.

**Trial Balance as on 31-3-2017**
| Debit Balances | Amt. (₹) | Credit Balances | Amt. (₹) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Drawings : Mahi | 3000 | Capital Accounts : Mahi | 20,000 |
| Drawings : Rahi | 2000 | Capital Accounts : Rahi | 12,500 |
| Opening stock | 1750 | Sales | 2,00,000 |
| Purchase | 1,38,750 | Purchase return | 1250 |
| Travelling expense : Rahi | 3000 | Discount and allowance | 1250 |
| Salesman | 5250 | Dividend on share of SBI | 50 |
| Salary : Accountant | 2500 | Bank A/c | 3000 |
| Collection clerk | 1250 | Creditors | 1250 |
| Shop rent | 900 | Loan borrowed from friend | 2500 |
| Debtors | 5000 | | |
| Carriage (goods) | 7500 | | |
| Advertisement expense | 10,000 | | |
| Prepaid rent of shop (1-4-16) | 75 | | |
| Discount and allowance | 4250 | | |
| Donation expense | 10,000 | | |
| Income tax | 12,500 | | |
| Professional tax | 125 | | |
| Bank overdraft interest | 6000 | | |
| Bank commission | 250 | | |
| Share of SBI | 500 | | |
| Fixed assets | 1250 | | |
| Fixed assets maintenance | 500 | | |
| Cash balance | 450 | | |
| Goodwill | 25,000 | | |
| **Total** | **2,41,800** | **Total** | **2,41,800** |

**Adjustments:**
(1) Provide 12 % interest on capital of partners and 5 % on drawings.
(2) 3 % commission on sales is payable to Mahi.
(3) Every month ₹ 300 is payable to Rahi for travelling expense done for business.
(4) ₹ 50 interest is outstanding on loan of friend.
(5) Shop rent is paid for 12 months for the year ending on 30-4-2017.
(6) Provide 20 % depreciation on fixed assets.
(7) There is doubtful recovery of ₹ 250.
(8) Closing stock ₹ 19,025.
question_hi:
माही और राही 6:4 के अनुपात में लाभ-हानि बांटने वाले साझेदार हैं। 31-3-2017 के दिए गए तलपट और समायोजनों से साझेदारी फर्म के अंतिम खाते तैयार करें।

**31-3-2017 को तलपट**
| डेबिट शेष | राशि (₹) | क्रेडिट शेष | राशि (₹) |
|---|---|---|---|
| आहरण : माही | 3000 | पूंजी खाते : माही | 20,000 |
| आहरण : राही | 2000 | पूंजी खाते : राही | 12,500 |
| प्रारंभिक स्टॉक | 1750 | बिक्री | 2,00,000 |
| खरीद | 1,38,750 | खरीद वापसी | 1250 |
| यात्रा व्यय : राही | 3000 | छूट और भत्ता | 1250 |
| सेल्समैन | 5250 | SBI के शेयर पर लाभांश | 50 |
| वेतन : एकाउंटेंट | 2500 | बैंक खाता | 3000 |
| कलेक्शन क्लर्क | 1250 | लेनदार | 1250 |
| दुकान का किराया | 900 | मित्र से लिया गया ऋण | 2500 |
| देनदार | 5000 | | |
| माल ढुलाई (कैरिज) | 7500 | | |
| विज्ञापन व्यय | 10,000 | | |
| दुकान का पूर्वदत्त किराया (1-4-16) | 75 | | |
| छूट और भत्ता | 4250 | | |
| दान व्यय | 10,000 | | |
| आयकर | 12,500 | | |
| व्यावसायिक कर | 125 | | |
| बैंक ओवरड्राफ्ट ब्याज | 6000 | | |
| बैंक कमीशन | 250 | | |
| SBI के शेयर | 500 | | |
| अचल संपत्तियां | 1250 | | |
| अचल संपत्तियों का रखरखाव | 500 | | |
| नकद शेष | 450 | | |
| ख्याति | 25,000 | | |
| **कुल** | **2,41,800** | **कुल** | **2,41,800** |

**समायोजन:**
(1) साझेदारों की पूंजी पर 12% और आहरण पर 5% ब्याज प्रदान करें।
(2) बिक्री पर 3% कमीशन माही को देय है।
(3) व्यापार के लिए किए गए यात्रा व्यय के लिए राही को हर महीने ₹300 देय हैं।
(4) मित्र के ऋण पर ₹50 ब्याज बकाया है।
(5) 30-4-2017 को समाप्त होने वाले वर्ष के लिए 12 महीने का दुकान का किराया चुकाया गया है।
(6) अचल संपत्तियों पर 20% मूल्यह्रास (Depreciation) प्रदान करें।
(7) ₹250 की संदिग्ध वसूली (Doubtful recovery) है।
(8) अंतिम स्टॉक ₹19,025 है।

**Trading Account for year ending on 31-3-2017**

| To Purchase (1,38,750 - 1250) | 1,37,500 | By Closing stock | 19,025 |

| To Shop rent (900 + 75 - 75) | 900 | By Dividend on share of SBI | 50 |
| To Salary of collection clerk | 1250 | | |
| To Advertisement expense A/c | 10,000 | | |
| To Salesman travelling expense | 5250 | | |
| To Discount - allowance A/c | 4250 | | |
| To Bank overdraft interest A/c | 6000 | | |
| To Bank commission A/c | 250 | | |
| To Fixed assets maintenance A/c | 500 | | |
| To Outstanding int. on loan of friend | 50 | | |

| To Income tax A/c | 12,500 | | |
| To P & L Appropriation A/c (Net profit) | 19,500 | | |

**Profit and Loss Appropriation Account for year ending on 31-3-2017**
| Dr Particulars | Amt. (₹) | Cr Particulars | Amt. (₹) |
|---|---|---|---|
| To Interest on capital (Mahi 2400, Rahi 1500) | 3900 | By Profit and loss A/c (Net profit) | 19,500 |

**Balance Sheet as on 31-3-17**

title: Illustration 10: Adjustments in Prepared Final Accounts
title_hi: चित्रण 10: तैयार अंतिम खातों में समायोजन
question:
Following are the annual accounts of partnership firm of Labh and Subh. After preparation of annual accounts the following adjustments are reported: (1) 5 % interest on capital is not calculated. (2) 10 % depreciation on fixed assets is to be provided. (3) Prepaid rent is ₹ 200. (4) Interest on investment is not received ₹ 400. (5) Maintain Bad debts reserve of ₹ 600. (6) Total of sales book is under cast by ₹ 2000. (7) Purchase of ₹ 800 is not recorded in the books. Write adjustment entries and prepare revised final accounts from the above information.

**Profit and Loss Account as on 31-3-17**
| Dr Particulars | Amt. (₹) | Cr Particulars | Amt. (₹) |
|---|---|---|---|
| To Cost of goods sold A/c | 1,16,000 | By Sales A/c | 1,96,000 |
| To Office expenses A/c | 20,000 | By Sundry income A/c | 2000 |
| To Sales expenses A/c | 16,000 | | |
| To Financial expenses A/c | 4000 | | |
| To Sundry expenses A/c | 4000 | | |
| To Partners' capital A/c (Net profit): Labh 22,800, Subh 15,200 | 38,000 | | |
| **Total** | **1,98,000** | **Total** | **1,98,000** |

**Balance Sheet as on 31-3-17**
| Capital-Liabilities | Amt. (₹) | Assets-Debts | Amt. (₹) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Capital: Labh (40,000 + 22,800 - 12,000) | 50,800 | Fixed assets | 60,000 |
| Capital: Shubh (30,000 + 15,200 - 6000) | 39,200 | Investments | 12,000 |
| Liabilities | 8000 | Current assets (with debtors) | 28,000 |
| Suspense A/c | 2000 | | |
| **Total** | **1,00,000** | **Total** | **1,00,000** |
solution:
**Adjustment Entries:**
1. Interest on capital A/c Dr 3500
   To Labh's capital A/c 2000
   To Shubh's capital A/c 1500
2. Depreciation A/c Dr 6000
   To fixed assets A/c 6000
3. Prepaid rent A/c Dr 200
   To rent A/c 200
4. Outstanding interest on investment A/c Dr 400
   To interest on investment A/c 400
5. Profit and Loss A/c Dr 600
   To Bad debts reserve A/c 600
6. Suspense A/c Dr 2000
   To sales A/c 2000
7. Purchase A/c Dr 800
   To creditors A/c 800

**Trading Account for year ending of 31-3-17**
| Dr Particulars | Amt. (₹) | Cr Particulars | Amt. (₹) |
|---|---|---|---|
| To Cost of goods sold A/c | 1,16,000 | By Sales | 1,96,000 |
| + Unrecorded purchase | 800 | + From suspense A/c | 2000 |
| To Profit and loss A/c (Gross profit) | 81,200 | | |
| **Total** | **1,98,000** | **Total** | **1,98,000** |

**Revised Profit and Loss Account for year ending on 31-3-17**
| Dr Particulars | Amt. (₹) | Cr Particulars | Amt. (₹) |
|---|---|---|---|
| To Office expense (20,000 - 200) | 19,800 | By Trading A/c (Gross profit) | 81,200 |
| To Sales expense | 16,000 | By Sundry income A/c | 2000 |
| To Financial expenses A/c | 4000 | By Interest on investment A/c | 400 |
| To Sundry expenses A/c | 4000 | | |
| To Depreciation on fixed assets | 6000 | | |
| To Bad debts reserve | 600 | | |
| To P & L App. A/c (Net profit) | 33,200 | | |
| **Total** | **83,600** | **Total** | **83,600** |

**Revised Profit and Loss Appropriation Account for year ending of 31-3-17**
| Dr Particulars | Amt. (₹) | Cr Particulars | Amt. (₹) |
|---|---|---|---|
| To Interest on partners' capital: Labh 2000, Shubh 1500 | 3500 | By Profit and loss A/c (Net profit) | 33,200 |
| To partners' capital A/c (Divisible profit): Labh 17,820, Shubh 11,880 | 29,700 | | |
| **Total** | **33,200** | **Total** | **33,200** |

**Partners' Capital Accounts**
| Date | Particulars | Labh (₹) | Shubh (₹) | Date | Particulars | Labh (₹) | Shubh (₹) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 31-3-17 | To Drawings A/c | 12,000 | 6000 | 1-4-16 | By Balance b/d | 40,000 | 30,000 |
| 31-3-17 | To Balance c/d | 47,820 | 37,380 | 31-3-17 | By Interest on capital A/c | 2000 | 1500 |
| | | | | 31-3-17 | By P&L App. A/c | 17,820 | 11,880 |
| | **Total** | **59,820** | **43,380** | | **Total** | **59,820** | **43,380** |

**Balance Sheet as on 31-3-17**
| Capital-Liabilities | Amt. (₹) | Assets-Debts | Amt. (₹) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Capital Accounts: Labh | 47,820 | Fixed assets (60,000 - 6000) | 54,000 |
| Capital Accounts: Shubh | 37,380 | Investments | 12,000 |
| Liabilities | 8000 | Debtors (28,000 - 600) | 27,400 |
| Unrecorded purchase | 800 | Interest outstanding on investments | 400 |
| | | Prepaid rent | 200 |
| **Total** | **94,000** | **Total** | **94,000** |
